0x000859.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008CA.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000952.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A7B.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000AB3.en: 「Oh dear...@　Not my finest hour, is it!」

0x000BB7.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　Not my style...」

0x000C0B.en: 「Blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000C7F.en: 「Guh! Nothing to do but fall back!!」

0x000CF5.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D5C.en: 「This is it... The rest is up to you.」

0x000E55.en: 「I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E93.en: 「Kyah! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000EDA.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x000F85.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who falls... I'm ejecting!」

0x0010C1.en: 「Ngh...! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x00112E.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001175.en: 「I'm sorry... The rest is up to you.」

0x0011AA.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...?!」

0x001296.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still not ready...!」

0x0012E4.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0013CE.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00140C.en: 「Well, well... so this is the end.」

0x00143B.en: 「I can't go on. I'll take my leave.」

0x0014C6.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x00162C.en: 「Ejecting...@ Ngh...! Can't even do it gracefully...」

0x001859.en: 「So I've still got a ways to go...!」

0x00192E.en: 「I've got no choice but to retreat...!」

0x00199A.en: 「Not being able to get Irui off the ship...@ that's my fault...」

0x0019FC.en: 「At least until her memories come back...@ or if that's not possible, until the next operation ends...」

0x001A79.en: 「Understood. There's no time to disembark her now,@ and if she wishes to stay with you,@ I'll allow her aboard as a special exception.」

0x001B64.en: 「However, as long as she acts alongside us,@ she'll be exposed to danger too.@ Don't forget that.」

0x001C2C.en: 「So that girl's staying aboard the Hiryu after all.」

0x001C9D.en: 「Sure, a cute little thing is always welcome.」

0x001CDE.en: 「Despinis, you two are close in age,@ so keep her company, okay?」

0x001D6C.en: 「But by now, isn't her family@ probably worried about her...?」

0x001DD4.en: 「We know her name, so can't we@ search for her with that or something?」

0x001E36.en: 「Right. From the look of her, she seems like a girl@ from a good family... no missing-person report?」

0x001EB6.en: 「I did look into it, but there were no@ real leads... and besides, maybe the people@ searching for her are already...」

0x001F5B.en: 「In times like these,@ that's certainly possible...」

0x001FAE.en: 「Worst case, she's all alone in the world...」

0x001FEE.en: 「That's... a very frightening thing...@ I was the same way, after all...」

0x002047.en: 「When this fight is over...@ if Irui has nowhere to go,@ I'll figure something out.」

0x0020F0.en: 「Yeah, I helped save her once, too...」

0x0021C9.en: 「This ship will soon reach the Arctic Ocean.@ Currently, the Ruina have deployed their forces@ centered around the north magnetic pole.」

0x002265.en: 「The Federation forces are splitting into three,@ advancing from the Greenland Sea, Baffin Bay,@ and the southern Queen Elizabeth Islands.」

0x002301.en: 「So we'll detour from the Beaufort Sea@ toward the North Pole and push into@ the area around the north magnetic pole.」

0x002382.en: 「Wouldn't that be the long way around?」

0x0023B9.en: 「Maybe we're just waiting to see how the Federation does first?」

0x002405.en: 「No, it's to avoid needless confusion.@ Then, after assessing the battle situation, we'll@ decide whether or not to push into the pole.」

0x0024B3.en: 「So it's possible we'll withdraw@ without doing anything?」

0x00253B.en: 「Our joining this fight is irregular.@ There's a chance the Federation or the Gaia Sabers@ could turn their blades on us.」

0x0025CB.en: 「No acting on your own, Joshua.@ If anything should happen to you or your machine,@ it's all for nothing.」

0x002695.en: 「Our objective is to gather intel on the@ Dimensional Rift and on what's called@ the Septempulum.」

0x002710.en: 「Also, if we make contact with the Federation@ or Gaia Sabers en route, we withdraw at once.@ Everyone, refrain from any rash actions.」

0x0027C7.en: (Withdraw, huh...@ But if we let this chance slip away...)

0x002817.en: 「Once we find an opening to slip through, we'll manage somehow.」

0x00286D.en: 「Breakthrough ops are the Steel Dragons' specialty,@ and the worse the odds get, the more@ some folks get fired up.」

0x002910.en: 「Our captain. And Lt. Katina, and Boss too.」

0x00298E.en: 「Current position, Beaufort Sea, NW0816.@ We're well into the Arctic Ocean now.」

0x0029FF.en: 「The sky around here is a little brighter, isn't it...」

0x002A3F.en: 「The sunlight's being blocked, so it's not@ the midnight sun, but...@ it may have something to do with the Septempulum.」

0x002AF9.en: 「We must bring back the sunlight as soon as possible...@ If enough people fall into despair,@ the Ruina will win without lifting a finger.」

0x002BB3.en: 「Here's hoping the Federation forces put up a good fight.」

0x002BF3.en: 「If they're on schedule, they've begun their advance by now.」

0x002C36.en: 「Yes. And most likely the Gaia Sabers too...」

0x002CA3.en: 「Master... are you truly certain of this?」

0x002CDA.en: 「Yes. It is the will of the Light Dragon. Go with her.」

0x002D1D.en: 「But if the priestess@ is aboard that ship...」

0x002D70.en: 「If the Divine Servant appears, so much the better.@ And if we reclaim the Azure Dragon, better still.」

0x002DCC.en: 「As you command.@ First, I wish to observe the situation.」

0x002E89.en: 「At a time like this...! All units, sortie now!@ But the Aile Chevalier and Blanche Neige@ stand by for the coming operation!」

0x002F3D.en: 「Tch, those things are kinda my weak spot.」

0x002F83.en: 「Come to think of it, back when we fought those@ space tadpoles, you said the same thing...」

0x002FE5.en: 「Don't say it! Now you've reminded me!@ Fish-types are my absolute worst!」

0x00305C.en: 「Huh, that's a surprise.@ I figured you were scared of nothing.」

0x0030D4.en: 「Well, it's one of Lt. Katina's@ few charm points, too.」

0x00315E.en: 「...Kusuha, I've got a bad feeling. Be careful.」

0x0031C9.en: 「We can't afford to be held up here.@ Take down the Yokijin quickly!」

0x00322E.en: 「Captain,@ emergency repairs to the damaged sections should be quick.」

0x00327E.en: 「S-seeing something like that up close...@ I can't bear it...」

0x0032E7.en: 「Ah, no...@ Thicken the barrage and keep the enemy from closing in.」

0x003359.en: 「Hmm... they're holding their own quite well.」

0x0034AC.en: 「The sin of forgetting your lord's grace@ and giving yourselves to mortals... that is the taint.」

0x0034FF.en: 「You call fighting alongside us to protect@ the mortal world a sin?!」

0x003561.en: 「Just so.@ The KoOhKi has returned to its proper form and rightful place.」

0x0035C0.en: 「That color... to me, it looks like proof@ that you forced the KoOhKi into submission!」

0x00364D.en: 「The KoOhKi is a Chokijin of the Four Gods, the White Tiger...@ How can a state stripped of its color@ be its proper form?!」

0x0036E6.en: 「Hmm, that stands to reason.@　No wonder Kanan set her sights@　on you, girl of the Seiryu.」

0x00376A.en: 「...Forcing the KoOhKi away is suspicious. If@ your master were truly rightful, the KoOhKi and@ RyuOhKi would have obeyed willingly!」

0x003839.en: 「The White Tiger's steadfast one bears a pure and honest spirit.@ Splendid... truly splendid.」

0x00388C.en: 「...That is your logic.@　All the Chokijin are kin to my master...@　The Blue Dragon and White Tiger foolishly defy that truth.」

0x003934.en: 「The KoOhKi and the RyuOhKi have fought@　alongside Kusuha and Brooklyn@　against the enemies threatening our world...」

0x0039B2.en: 「I've seen it with my own eyes.@　The logic of outsiders holds no sway over us.」

0x003A11.en: 「Outsider...@　heh, true enough. That's what I am now.」

0x003A68.en: 「But the other four gods' Chokijin obey my master.@　It is the Blue Dragon and White Tiger who have strayed.」

0x003AF4.en: 「Why, you've twisted the very form of your Chokijin,@　not just its color.」

0x003B75.en: 「Don't let her mislead you, Kusuha.@　Believe in the RyuJinKi, like you always have.」

0x003BE3.en: 「I believe in the KoOhKi too... and I'll take it back.」

0x003C42.en: 「It coming out all black is exactly@　the kind of pattern you'd expect.@　They definitely did something to it over there.」

0x003CE7.en: 「That's right...@　the G Thundergate was black when it showed up too.@　And you know how that turned out.」

0x003D68.en: 「Got it... let's take back the KoOhKi!」

0x003DAB.en: 「That's my line!@　White Tiger, you take the Blue Dragon! I'll handle that Amanotorifune!」

0x003E83.en: 「It's okay, Irui. Just believe in everyone.」

0x003ED9.en: 「Anyone near the Hiryu, protect her!@　Brooklyn, you hold back the KoOhKi!」

0x003F59.en: 「Roger!@　Kusuha, I'll try to talk the KoOhKi down!@　Cover me!」

0x003FFA.en: 「You're the Chokijin that guards our world, right!?@　That's why you needed my power!@　Remember that!」

0x0040AB.en: 「You won't answer...!@　But I believe in you... in the words you said@　to me and Kusuha when we first met!」

0x00413E.en: 「Whatever curse binds you,@　I'll break it by force if I have to!」

0x004191.en: 「First I have to stop the KoOhKi from moving...!」

0x0041CE.en: 「I've got to stop the KoOhKi somehow...!@　RyuJinKi, lend me your strength!」

0x004233.en: 「Please, answer me!@　Answer me, Bullet, the RyuJinKi!」

0x00427D.en: 「To think you'd bring ruin to our world@　alongside the Yokijin...@　I don't want to see you like this...」

0x004307.en: 「That's why I'm going to stop you!」

0x00438E.en: 「Could it be that you, like the KoOhKi...」

0x0043C5.en: 「Silence!@　If you'll get in my way, I'll strike you down@　before the rest!」

0x004431.en: （...What is this?@　This feeling, like someone else is inside me...?@　Cold, and dark... what is this...?）

0x0044C4.en: （The Sympatia's sync gauge is fluctuating...@　Is it drawing near...?）

0x0045B9.en: 「Flying objects incoming! Straight in from twelve o'clock!@　Identifying... it's the Ruina!」

0x004624.en: 「That ship again.@　Humans, attacking even from a place like this.」

0x004726.en: 「Captain,@ Josh and Lim are requesting launch clearance.」

0x004776.en: 「If our foe is that Melior Esse, best to let them go.@　We may learn something new.」

0x004849.en: （So you were here after all.@　That's how I knew where that ship was.）

0x0048D6.en: （That human reads my thoughts.@　Dangerous. I must eliminate him at once.@　That is why I came here.）

0x00496C.en: （Wait!@　Why is it only the two of us who end up like this!?@　Do you know something!?）

0x0049E4.en: （Confusion, anger... are these that man's emotions?@　Joshua Radcliff...@　Why do I know this?）

0x004A77.en: （No, I must not seek the reason.@　I need only eliminate him.）

0x004B27.en: （The dark and the cold grew stronger...?@　Did she close off her heart...?）

0x004B7A.en: 「Tch, of all times for them to show up!」

0x004BA8.en: 「Even now the Shinboku won't reveal themselves...」

0x004C19.en: 「...Master,@　we should avoid crossing swords with them here.」

0x004C6F.en: 「I have already accomplished my purpose.@　Do as you see fit.」

0x004D25.en: 「Don't chase them, Bullet.@　The Ruina are right in front of us.」

0x004D82.en: 「Glacies, we're pressing on...!@　To bring back the light of the sun.」

0x004DE1.en: 「Yeah, once the sun shows its face,@　the light of hope comes into view too!」

0x004E86.en: 「When that feeling is crushed,@　your despair and suffering will only grow.@　And we shall feed upon it...!」

0x004F16.en: 「Ngh, the Sympatia again...!@　And this feeling... it's different from last time...!?」

0x004F93.en: （Why?@　Even though she closed her heart, why is it still like this...!）

0x004FE6.en: （Guh, the Fabularis...!@　Even with it closed off, just having that human nearby@　is enough to degrade my functions...!?）

0x0050C5.en: （It opened a little...!? She's reaching out... to me...!）

0x005108.en: （This phenomenon... I have to be sure of it...!）

0x00514F.en: 「Fall back, Glacies.@　Fighting them alone is too dangerous.」

0x0051C7.en: 「A human squad is planning to force their way through here...@　That appears to be their true aim.」

0x005242.en: 「Return, and defend the Septemplum with me.」

0x0052C0.en: 「Melior Esse units fleeing the combat zone at high speed!」

0x005300.en: 「Heading for the north magnetic pole.@　What are your orders, Captain?」

0x005369.en: 「XO, if we head for the north magnetic pole from here,@　what are the odds we run into Federation forces?」

0x0053DA.en: 「We're entering from the opposite direction,@　so I don't think we'll run head-on into them...」

0x005460.en: 「But we're all after the same place.@　A three-way standoff at the pole... no, with the Ruina,@　a four-way standoff is entirely possible.」

0x005508.en: 「Nothing ventured, nothing gained, as they say.@　Besides, I'm concerned about Josh and Glacies as well.」

0x0055A1.en: 「Understood.@　This ship will push straight on to the north magnetic pole.」
